books.author: Henric Andelson
books.title: The Golden Age of the Poster
books.description: The Golden Age of the Poster celebrates one of the most influential periods in the history of graphic design. Between the late nineteenth century and the outbreak of the First World War, artists transformed the advertising poster into an art form, filling the streets of Europe and America with bold colour, elegant typography, and unforgettable imagery.

books.author: Eleanor Harte
books.title: The Glove Shop on Market Lane
books.description:
Mollie Tremaine has spent years building a life of her own.

After her father's death, she takes over Tremaine & Co., the glove shop on Market Lane, determined to keep the business alive despite mounting debts, unreliable suppliers, and a town that doubts a young woman can manage such responsibilities alone.

When a series of unpaid accounts and troubling irregularities threaten the shop's future, Mollie has little choice but to accept help from Jory Penrose, a practical, sharp-eyed shipping agent with problems of his own. What begins as a reluctant partnership soon draws them into long days of ledgers, deliveries, market negotiations, and the quiet work of saving a business that means everything to her.

As pressures mount from creditors, competitors, and secrets buried in the town's commercial past, Mollie finds herself relying on Jory more than she ever intended. Yet trust has never come easily, and surrendering her independence may be the greatest risk of all.

Set along the Cornish coast, The Glove Shop on Market Lane is a warm and atmospheric historical romance filled with family obligations, small-town rivalries, hard-won trust, and a slow-burning love story built through shared work and quiet devotion.

Perfect for readers who enjoy:

    Historical romance
    Slow-burn relationships
    Independent heroines
    Victorian Cornwall
    Small-town secrets
    Family businesses and inherited responsibilities
    Gentle emotional tension with a satisfying happily-ever-after
